name: Hidden Alcove
description: A secret space that knows when it has been found. It owns the discovery check — entered volume plus actually seen, reusing world.vision_system's explored-tile state rather than keeping a second fog map, because two sources of 'have I seen this' is how secrets announce themselves through walls — and the one-shot discovered flag per alcove that makes the fanfare fire exactly once per save. The reward is deliberately not granted here: world.alcoveDiscovered is an announcement, and whether it means a loot roll, a lore entry, or a statue is the listener's genre decision. It does not own the hinting that leads a player close (ui.guided_hint_system pings near, never reveals) and it does not own counting secrets toward completion; progression.completion_tracker listens for the same event and does the arithmetic.

inputs.name: alcoveId
inputs.description: Stable id for this alcove, used as the discovered-flag key and by completion tracking's region definitions.

inputs.name: discoveryRequiresLineOfSight
inputs.description: When true, entering the volume is not enough — the alcove must be visible via the vision system. Prevents accidentally 'finding' a secret by clipping its trigger in the dark.

inputs.name: interactToConfirm
inputs.description: When true, discovery completes only on input.interact inside the volume, for secrets that should feel examined rather than stumbled into.

inputs.name: fanfareCueId
inputs.description: Audio cue id played on first discovery. Just the id — presentation.audio_system owns playback and mixing.

outputs.name: discovered
outputs.description: One-shot flag per alcove. Once true it never resets within the save.

outputs.name: discoveryCount
outputs.description: Total discoveries this session, exposed for stats and achievement sinks.
